I’m recording this diagnosis and a single-axis 1550-cap hypothesis before editing the policy, as the skill requires.

The single candidate is now a 1550 deg/time² posterior-cap test with every other gait, steering, and observation choice unchanged. I also materially revised the durable lesson: the evidence now supersedes the old “stop at 1700” rule, records the 1650/1600 gains and load plateau, and limits continuation to one isolated step with explicit rejection bounds.
